facts.en: Completed an education administration diploma at Fictional Lindenbell College in 2017.
facts.zh: 2017 年在虚构椴铃学院完成教育行政文凭课程。

facts.en: Paid course records assistant at Fictional Claybridge Adult College from 2017-09 to 2021-06.
facts.zh: 2017-09 至 2021-06 在虚构陶桥成人学院任有薪课程档案助理。

facts.en: Paid examination arrangements coordinator at Fictional Quillcourt Learning from 2021-08 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2021-08 至 2026-08 在虚构羽庭学习中心任有薪考试安排协调员。

facts.en: Transcribes approved access arrangements into examination-room schedules and checks them against the authorization record.
facts.zh: 将获批考试便利安排录入考场排程，并依据授权记录核对。

facts.en: Books rooms and support-staff slots from the examination manager’s approved allocation plan.
facts.zh: 依据考试经理批准的分配计划预订房间及支持人员时段。

facts.en: The qualified assessor determines recommended adjustments, and the examination manager approves their implementation.
facts.zh: 合资格评估人员确定建议调整措施，考试经理批准实施。

facts.en: Contacts learners using approved appointment details and routes requests for changed arrangements back to the manager.
facts.zh: 使用获批预约信息联系学习者，并将变更安排请求转交经理。

facts.en: Coordinated room and staff records for a 2025-06 examination series.
facts.zh: 为 2025-06 考试季协调房间及人员记录。

facts.en: The series schedule contained 72 learner examination sittings for 28 distinct learners because some learners were scheduled for multiple papers.
facts.zh: 该考试季排程包含 28 名不同学习者的 72 人次应考安排，因为部分学习者被安排参加多科考试。

facts.en: The schedule was not an attendance register and did not report examination pass rates.
facts.zh: 该排程并非出席登记册，亦未报告考试通过率。

facts.en: Personally checked schedule-to-authorization matches and logged 5 items for clarification before manager approval.
facts.zh: 个人核对排程与授权记录的一致性，并在经理批准前记录 5 项待澄清事项。

facts.en: Uses restricted-access spreadsheets, room calendars and versioned examination checklists.
facts.zh: 使用限制访问的电子表格、房间日历及带版本记录的考试核对表。

facts.en: Completed internal confidential-record handling training in 2022-01.
facts.zh: 2022-01 完成内部保密记录处理培训。

facts.en: Maintains a register of document receipts and missing approvals without changing assessors’ findings.
facts.zh: 维护文件收取及缺失审批登记册，不修改评估人员的结论。

facts.en: Volunteers with Fictional Seedpage Reading Circle, preparing meeting notices and lending-book lists.
facts.zh: 在虚构种页阅读社做志愿者，准备会议通知及借书清单。

facts.en: Created a personal set of illustrated vocabulary cards in 2024 for leisure word games, not formal learner assessment.
facts.zh: 2024 年制作个人插画词汇卡用于休闲文字游戏，而非正式学习者评估。

facts.en: Enjoys making paper bookmark tassels and solving word puzzles.
facts.zh: 爱好制作纸书签流苏及解文字谜题。

facts.en: Provides daily pre-examination handovers identifying unconfirmed rooms, staff cover and approval questions.
facts.zh: 提供每日考前交接，标明未确认房间、人员补位及审批问题。
